koblitz.compact_orbit.n61_panel.label: Multi-target batch diagnostic only: a=0 n=61 compact-orbit shared-log DLP vs frozen KS v2 batched rho at L>=1024
koblitz.compact_orbit.n61_panel.k_selection: lowest whole-process wall on a disjoint tune corpus; candidates whose estimated IC RSS (ic_rss_model) plus headroom exceeds available memory are skipped and recorded. By default the tune corpus has the panel's L targets (corpora.tune at L); launch-panel --tune-targets T tunes on corpora.tune at L=T instead (grid from k_candidates_by_tune_targets), records tune_targets in state.json, k_tune.json and candidate.json, and checks the tune corpus is disjoint from the panel corpus. Runs before the option have no tune_targets field and tuned at the panel's L.

ic_rss_model.basis: K^2*n regular states of 24 B (touched) plus a 16 B-slot root table sized to next_pow2(4*K^2*n); matches measured n=61 peaks at K=400..1200 within +0.3..+4%. The table doubles above K=1482 (19.1 GiB at K=1500), so K=1480 is the largest K below that boundary.
ic_rss_model.superseded: ic_bytes_per_regular_state = 94 (flat), which under-predicted K>=800 by up to 23% (7.7 GiB estimated vs 10.0 measured at K=1200)
